verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud ships an auto-configured MCP server, so users can interact with their project's data in natural language from AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Cursor. It also offers AI-powered NLP search and AnswerSession chat experiences. The documented scope is natural-language querying of data, not operating or administering the product (configuration, data-source management, deployments) through natural-language commands. missing for 10: documented natural-language control of product operations beyond data querying, a list of what the MCP server's tools can do, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Every Orama Cloud project comes with an MCP server that is automatically configured to interact with your project's data.
you'll be able to interact with your data from different AI interfaces, including ChatGPT, Cursor, and many other.
we introduced a new feature called **AnswerSession** that allows you to perform ChatGPT-like experiences on your website.
